title: div/span deprecation guidance still teaches replacements that are not drop-in, and never names `box`
body:
Found while executing #3965 (minting `box`, migrating the catalog off `div`) — **not addressed there**, because every text involved is pinned by ruling and the pin-moving is a judged change of its own.

Blocked-by: #3965 (the `box` type must land first; this card is actionable once that PR merges).

## The defect

Once `box` exists, the deprecation guidance for `div` points authors at the WRONG replacements, in four places that all say the same thing:

1. `DIV_DEPRECATION_NOTICE` in `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/div.tsx` — bullets recommend `card` / `flex` / `container` / `stack` / `grid`;
2. the machine-readable `deprecated.replacement` on the same registration (what a gate repeats to authors, objectui#6674);
3. `content/docs/components/basic/div.mdx` — the Migration Guide teaches card/flex/grid conversions;
4. the `components-basic-div` catalog guidance fixtures (`use-card-instead`, `flex-layout`, `grid-layout`).

Every one of those named replacements was MEASURED non-drop-in on #3965 (each injects layout; `card` adds a wrapper element; 4 `body`-authoring nodes lose content silently on a blind swap — evidence in the 2026-08-29T04:07 escalation comment on #3965 and in `examples/schema-catalog/test/deprecated-component-types.test.ts`). The one actually-mechanical replacement, `box`, is the one the guidance never mentions. AI authors following the notice will keep reproducing the exact conversions the #3965 measurements rejected.

## Why this was not a rider on #3965

The guidance sentences are pinned byte-for-byte by four tests (`div-deprecation-provenance`, `div-deprecation-warn-once`, and the span pair), and objectui#4000 records the wording as a ruled invariant ("the migration guidance below is byte-for-byte what it was"). `packages/components/src/__tests__/deprecation-guidance-agreement.test.tsx` (objectui#6823) additionally asserts the notice bullets and `deprecated.replacement` offer the SAME set of quoted type names, and its header states explicitly that moving those pins "is a judged change of its own and not a rider". So updating the guidance means re-ruling the pinned wording — a deliberate, small, but judged edit across the four surfaces above plus their pins.

## Suggested shape (for triage, not binding)

Name `box` first for the neutral-wrapper case and keep `card`/`flex`/`container`/`stack`/`grid` for the cases where their layout semantics are wanted; update notice + declaration together (the #6823 agreement test forces them to move in lockstep); refresh div.mdx and consider whether the `components-basic-div` guidance fixtures should demonstrate `div`→`box` instead of `div`→card/flex/grid. The `span` notice is a separate judgment (`box` is block-level; `span`'s replacement story is unchanged).
